skill_name: Apply the KISS principle to a software design problem.
workflow: The KISS (Keep It Simple, Stupid) principle can be applied to software design problems by simplifying the design to its most essential features. This involves reducing the complexity, time and effort required to develop, maintain or use the software. It means avoiding feature creep, where unnecessary features and complexity are added to the software design.
